content.comment_body: Hello, A customer experienced a problem: after purchasing a [product_name] about a year ago, the program stored inside is now missing. I believe the [product_name]'s memory requires power to retain data, but I would like to know exactly how long it can remain powered off before losing information from its memory. Another question: when using the program module card, only the module card is needed to run the program, not the internal memory. In this scenario, how long can the module card (or [product_name] with the card installed) be powered off before losing the data stored in the card's memory? Thank you for your responses.

Hello, Under ideal conditions, the [product_name] can retain its program for approximately 80 hours without power. When you use the memory card accessory, you can store your program on it, and the data will persist. If there is no program present in the [product_name] after power is restored, it will automatically reload the program from the memory card. For more details, refer to the user manual at [url], especially chapter 6 and section 2.4. Best regards, [user_name]

The program always remains stored in the [product_name]. Only the clock may not show the current time after extended periods. If your program does not require the clock function, you can keep the programmed [product_name] in storage for years. If you use the clock, you must set the correct time after powering up. However, the actual program will not be deleted.

Hello, I have encountered this issue twice. We solved it by opening the [product_name] and physically blocking the ESC button with some paper. The problem was caused by individuals pressing buttons and accidentally deleting the program. You may also consider setting a password to protect your program. Hope this information is helpful!

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are seeking clarity on how long [product_name] devices and their memory cards can retain programmed data when powered off. Confusion persists regarding retention times for both internal and external memories. Some have identified that unintentional device interaction may result in program loss, emphasizing the need for robust safeguards against accidental or unauthorized changes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] or its associated memory card to reliably store program data for significant periods without power and want precise retention guarantees. They also wish for effective measures to prevent accidental program loss due to unintended interference.
